name: mars-poc
description: Mars Sandbox: hot-loaded Wasm behaviours on a sourced Mars knowledge layer

scripts.facts:check: node facts/validate.mjs --check && node facts/derive/recompute.mjs && node runtime/gen_fact_keys.mjs --check
scripts.test: npm run facts:check && node --test --test-timeout=30000 test/facts.test.mjs test/recompute.test.mjs test/terrain.test.mjs test/climatology.test.mjs test/runtime.test.mjs test/hostapi.test.mjs && node test/run.mjs
